title: Optional Chaining [?.]
description:
## The Problem
Accessing nested properties that might not exist crashes:
```ts
const video = { title: "Cat" };
console.log(video.stats.views);  // ERROR! stats is undefined
```

## The Fix: ?.
Optional chaining returns `undefined` instead of crashing:
```ts
console.log(video.stats?.views);  // undefined (no crash)
```

You can chain multiple levels:
```ts
const channel = {
    name: "Steve's Channel",
    topVideo: undefined
};
console.log(channel.topVideo?.title?.toUpperCase());  // undefined
```

Also works with methods:
```ts
channel.getStats?.();  // calls getStats if it exists, undefined if not
```

---
## Assignment:
Given the `channel` object, safely print:
1. The channel name
2. The top video title (might not exist)
3. The top video's author name (definitely doesn't exist)
expectedOutput:
MeTube Gaming
Epic Fail Compilation
